notes: Published photographs go up as files of their own, so the report is a few hundred kilobytes instead of thirty megabytes and opens straight away on a telephone. The AD/SB tab searches the Federal Register itself and shows each applicability paragraph word for word. Checklists can be your own, uploaded per aircraft type, with appendix D kept whatever you load. And the shop can keep its own directive list per type — the pre-1994 directives the Register cannot see, researched once and reused on every aeroplane of that type after.
